built: 2026-11-01 by the coordinator from data/derived/bundle_v1 (logs/bundle_v1_record.json) and the deposit data notes; definitions, formats and coverage only, no summary statistics

provenance.deposit: OSF node a47e9, license CC-By 4.0 per the OSF API; files validated in logs/deposit_validation_pre.json
provenance.author_processing: All deposit files were prepared by the depositor. Files flagged (*) were pre-processed by the depositor; files flagged (**) were computed by the depositor from OpenStreetMap full-history files. Neither the raw OpenStreetMap history nor the depositor's processing code is part of this study's inputs.
provenance.public_file: Census TIGER/Line 2010 county file tl_2010_us_county10.zip, from www2.census.gov (logs/tiger_receipt.json)
provenance.no_dictionary: The deposit has no variable dictionary. Column meanings below come only from the column names, stored labels and the deposit's one-line file notes.

loader_equivalence: R (data.table, haven, readxl) and Python (pandas) read identical row and column counts and identical cell text for every file (logs/loader_check_compare.json), with two noted differences: data.table strips the leading space of the boundary-counties.csv header ' border counties' (content identical), and timing.xlsx FIPS is stored as text cells, which pandas converts to integers and readxl keeps as text with leading zeros (numerically identical).

quarterly.csv.format: tab-separated, header row, values double-quoted in most lines

keys.geoid: county FIPS stored as text without leading zero (4 digits for state codes 01-09)

quarterly.csv.column_types: all columns other than geoid and quarter are numeric counts or shares when parsed
quarterly.csv.coverage: 3112 distinct counties; 38 distinct quarter values from 2005q2 to 2014q4 (2005q1 and 2005q3 never appear); counties appear in between 3 and 36 quarters; there is no duplicate county-quarter
quarterly.csv.irregular_lines: 3111 lines inside the file repeat the header (quoted), so every column reads as text until they are removed; 2 lines have an empty quarter and contain header names as values in the last two columns
quarterly.csv.absent_rows: County-quarters not present in the file are not explained by the deposit notes

h12.csv.deposit_note: object-level edited activity in the state of Florida (**)

columns.1: integer identifier up to 16 digits; 878068 distinct values
columns.2: UTC timestamp text YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, from 2006-09-25 to 2014-12-21
columns.3: pseudonymous contributor code U<n> (original user names replaced; equality preserved)
columns.4: text category; 150 distinct values, OpenStreetMap highway-type style tags with spelling variants and combined values
columns.5: integer county FIPS, 67 distinct Florida codes (12001-12133)

tiger_census_2008q2.csv.deposit_note: lengths and counts by county of ways added to OpenStreetMap by the TIGER import, as of 2008q2 (**)

tiger_osm_2018.csv.deposit_note: lengths and counts of TIGER highways as of 2018, from TIGER/Line shapefiles (*)

county_lookup.csv.deposit_note: treatment status by county coded from Fusaro and Avnayim (2006)

acs5year.dta.deposit_note: control variables from the American Community Survey 5-year data, years 2005-2011
acs5year.dta.coverage: 3223 distinct counties, 52 state codes, acsyear 2005 to 2011, no duplicate county-year
acs5year.dta.label_note: SE_T codes are Social Explorer ACS table codes as stored in the file

timing.xlsx.deposit_note: U.S. Census Bureau data on scheduled timing of MTAIP updates, obtained by personal communication
timing.xlsx.missing: Sch SB Delivery blank in 4 rows, SB Selected in 3, Thread in 5

boundary-counties.csv.format: comma-separated, header row; second header has a leading space

distance.csv.deposit_note: driving distance between origin and destination pairs from OSRM and Google Maps (queried in 2017)

amenitycheck.csv.deposit_note: match score for establishment names for restaurants in proprietary InfoUSA data compared with OpenStreetMap as of 2018 (*)

google_trends.csv.deposit_note: popularity of 'Google Maps' on Google Trends, downloaded April 2017

maptimes.csv.deposit_note: OpenStreetMap local community groups (maptime chapters), as of April 2017

osm-events.csv.deposit_note: OpenStreetMap local in-person events, as of April 2017

columns.field_4: event type: Conference, Mapping party, Meeting, Pizza, Social, Speaking
columns.field_3: pseudonymous event-description code E<n> (free text replaced; equality preserved)
columns.name: county name

tl_2010_us_county10.zip.software_note: R package sf is not installed; the .dbf attributes are readable with foreign::read.dbf. Python geopandas and shapely are installed.
